crossRefs.note: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hanun
people.line: An Ammonite king who mistreated David's envoys.

translations.web: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.
translations.bsb: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved their beards, cut off their garments at the hips, and sent them away.
translations.kjv: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
translations.asv: So Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
